title: EyeArt 2.1.0: diabetic retinopathy detection in primary care
constructedNotice: CONSTRUCTED. The vendor claims and the hospital intended use are written for this demonstration. They were not issued by Eyenuk, Inc. and say nothing about that company. The regulator, registry and publication records they are checked against are real and were retrieved on the dates shown.

intended.text: Can our primary-care clinics use EyeArt 2.1.0 to screen adults with diabetes and no previous diagnosis of more than mild diabetic retinopathy, and does the evidence behind a sensitivity of at least 85 percent apply to that use?

exclusions: previously diagnosed with more than mild diabetic retinopathy

claims.text: Detects more than mild diabetic retinopathy in adults with diabetes in primary care and eye care settings, using the Canon CR-2 AF or CR-2 Plus AF camera.
Validated for patients with diabetes of all ages, including children.
Supports prioritisation of diabetic eye disease for patients presenting to the emergency department or admitted to hospital.
The 2026 release, version 3.0, is covered by the same clearance and the same pivotal study.
Works with any colour fundus camera.
Diagnoses diabetic retinopathy and replaces the dilated eye examination.
